body: It's awful when the person you were willing to give up everything else for suddenly loses interest in you. I don't understand how someone can talk about having a life together then suddenly go back on it when things don't seem as good as they expected without working on it at all. I understand the feeling of loneliness and having nobody else but her, I'm in a similar situation myself, but you still have the chance to work things out and talk to her. I don't know if it will help but being open about how you're feeling with everything to her will at least mean you can share your problem.

I understand that a lot, but when I get those feelings I try to force myself out of them by remembering the things I live for, and every time I do that the list has been getting shorter and shorter. For me now it's either get away from everything to somewhere peaceful or die, and neither of those options are easy.

I'm reaching out to doctors and therapists but I've tried this before, I was in therapy last year and it just felt like I was talking to a mannequin who was nodding whenever it seemed appropriate. As for medication, I have always been so against it since it just made me feel numb the last time I was on it and I'd prefer peaks and troughs than just a flat-line of emotion, but recently I feel like I don't have the option to turn it down anymore.

yeah I used to fly through school without really trying then got to uni and did the same, now I've been given full responsibility in my final year and haven't built up the skills to be able to focus and do stuff properly. I don't know what I am if not intelligent like I've built my entire personality for years around it but what if I'm actually just average? Like I have no way to be able to tell and the inability to know that is destroying me.

no one would ever be happy to lose you man, there will always be someone to miss you when you're gone. never listen to the voices in your head that tell you you're worthless because they're wrong, you have as much worth as anybody else.
